label: Red fox
tells: The eyes are glassy and symmetrical, with identical catchlights in both.
The paws are black blobs — no toes, claws or pads.
The legs are straight tubes with no visible joints.
The snow shows no footprints and no shadow under the animal.

label: Common raven
tells: Feathers read as smooth painted layers rather than overlapping barbs.
The beak has no nostril detail and the eye lacks a nictitating membrane.
The branch meets the feet with no grip or compression.

label: European robin
tells: The breast orange bleeds into surrounding feathers without a defined edge.
Whiskers or thin twigs often vanish mid-line or duplicate.
Background bokeh is uniformly round rather than varied.

label: Grey seal
tells: Wet fur lacks individual clumping; it reads as one glossy surface.
Rocks and water meet with no tide line or foam.
The eye is a flat dark bead without a wet highlight.

label: Red deer
tells: Antler tines branch asymmetrically or merge into each other.
The coat is uniformly smooth instead of showing clumped winter fur.
No shadow anchors the hooves to the ground.
